ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 45:55 ratio of low-intensity black pixels (central peduncle and mid-lobes) to high-intensity white pixels (distal lobes and scar tissue).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous low-intensity (black) region occupying the central 40% of the fluke width. High-intensity (white) contiguous blobs occupy the left and right distal lobes, featuring peripheral low-intensity mottling and a distinct high-intensity circular ring on the left central quadrant.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 68 degrees and a vertical depth reaching the peduncle junction.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous serrated boundary with high-frequency, low-amplitude peaks (2-5 pixels) interspersed with irregular, deeper valleys (10-15 pixels), most pronounced on the left lobe's trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Initial convex sweep from the median notch transitioning into a broad concavity toward the distal tips, terminating in sharp, high-contrast points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: A singular, prominent high-intensity circular annular scar ('donut' shape) located on the left side of the central dark pigmentation. Small, high-contrast textured clusters (barnacles) are present at the extreme tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple faint, low-intensity linear streaks visible on the white field of the right distal lobe, trending diagonally from the leading edge toward the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinctive annular depigmentation scar on the central-left fluke; parasitic or barnacle encrustations concentrated on the distal lobe terminals.
other_distinctive_markers: The eye-like circular white ring within the central black pigmentation serves as a highly unique diagnostic feature.
